title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的主线，是 agent 开始从“会回答”走向“能交付”。Claude Ship 把 code review、修复 failing checks 和审批串进了一个 shipping loop；Replit 的 swarm 研究则提醒我们，agent 越多不一定越好，组织方式才是关键。另一边，OpenAI 正在把 dots 变成内部工作方式，Anthropic 把 skills 和 connectors 统一成 plugins，而 Aaron Levie 看到的是更大的商业变化：专家站在前端把关，agent 在后端把服务产能拉开。

archive.title: 交付闭环日报
archive.desc: AI agent 正从聊天工具进入交付系统：代码、swarm、插件和专业服务都在围绕“如何可靠地产出结果”重构。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-11-24 source feeds.

sections.title: Shipping Becomes the Product / 交付本身成为产品
sections.desc: 下一代 coding agent 的竞争点，不只是写代码，而是把 review、修复和审批一起跑完。

rewrite: Claude creator Boris Cherny announces Claude Ship in beta for Team and Enterprise: the missing layer between an agent writing code and a team actually shipping it.

He says Code Review looks for bugs, PR Steward works on fixes and failing checks, and Claude Approvals approves what the team's policy allows. His practical advice is to start with one repo and run Approvals in observe mode until the team trusts it.
original: A year ago we launched Opus 4.5, the first model to write 100% of my code.
Shipping PRs hasn’t caught up, so today we’re launching Claude Ship in beta for Team and Enterprise.
I’d start with one repo and run Approvals in observe mode until you trust it.

rewrite: Claude 创作者 Boris Cherny 宣布，Claude Ship 面向 Team 和 Enterprise 开启 beta：agent 会写代码之后，团队真正把代码 ship 出去所缺的那一层来了。
Code Review 负责找 bug，PR Steward 处理修复和 failing checks，Claude Approvals 则按团队策略批准变更。他的实操建议很克制：先从一个 repo 开始，把 Approvals 放在 observe mode，等团队建立信任。
original: 一年前我们发布了 Opus 4.5，它是第一个能写出我 100% 代码的模型。
但 PR 的交付还没有跟上，所以今天我们发布 Team 和 Enterprise 版的 Claude Ship beta。
建议先从一个 repo 开始，把 Approvals 放在 observe mode，直到你信任它。

rewrite: OpenAI's Thibault Sottiaux says dots are quickly becoming the primary way to get things done inside OpenAI, with dots even building the dots system. The interesting signal is organizational: the unit of work is shifting from a person using a tool to small agents carrying work through a system.
original: Inside OpenAI, dots are quickly becoming the primary way to get things done. We have dots building the dots system.

rewrite: OpenAI 的 Thibault Sottiaux 说，dots 正迅速成为 OpenAI 内部完成工作的主要方式，甚至已经出现“用 dots 构建 dots 系统”。真正有意思的是组织方式：工作的基本单位正在从“人使用工具”，变成小型 agent 把任务穿过一整套系统。
original: 在 OpenAI 内部，dots 正迅速成为完成工作的主要方式。我们还有 dots 在构建 dots 系统。

sections.title: Swarm Intelligence Has a Shape / Swarm 智能开始显现结构
sections.desc: 多 agent 的收益不是简单堆数量，任务能否并行、agent 如何组织，决定了集体表现。

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad shares new research on scaling laws for agent swarms. With a fixed two-hour window, Opus 5.5 went from a 3.7x speedup with one agent to 18.9x with 32 agents on NumPy, but GPT-6.2 Astra showed negative scaling beyond eight agents.

The result is less 'more agents is better' than 'organization matters'. Decentralized swarms scaled better than centralized coordination, parallelizability predicted performance, and individual model intelligence was a poor predictor of collective intelligence.
original: Scaling the number of agents can yield dramatic performance gains, but unlike traditional scaling laws, more compute doesn't necessarily translate into better results, and how agents organize themselves matters.
Decentralized swarms scaled better than those that relied on centralized coordination.
Individual model intelligence is a poor predictor of collective intelligence.

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 分享了关于 agent swarm scaling laws 的新研究。在固定两小时窗口里，Opus 5.5 在 NumPy 任务上从单 agent 的 3.7 倍加速提升到 32 个 agent 的 18.9 倍，但 GPT-6.2 Astra 在超过 8 个 agent 后反而出现负向扩展。
结论不是“agent 越多越好”，而是“组织方式很重要”：去中心化 swarm 比中心化协调扩展得更好，任务能否并行是强预测指标，而单个模型的智能程度并不能很好预测集体智能。
original: 扩大 agent 数量可以带来显著性能提升，但和传统 scaling laws 不同，更多 compute 不一定带来更好结果，agent 如何组织自己很重要。
去中心化 swarm 比依赖中心化协调的 swarm 扩展得更好。
单个模型的智能程度并不是集体智能的好预测指标。

rewrite: Meta AI leader Madhu Guru argues that 'data' badly undersells what powers model development. Great data is not inert commodity; it encodes high-value knowledge, taste and expertise, often in structures that did not previously exist.
His point is a useful correction to the compute-only story: data remains one of the fundamental building blocks for creating more capable intelligence across domains.
original: Great data encodes incredibly high value knowledge, taste and expertise, often articulated and structured in ways that did not exist previously.
Data will continue to be incredibly central to the intelligence industry.

rewrite: Meta AI 负责人 Madhu Guru 认为，“data”这个词严重低估了它在模型开发中的价值。好的 data 不是惰性的商品，而是编码了高价值的知识、品味和 expertise，很多内容甚至以过去不存在的方式被表达和结构化。
这是对“只要堆 compute”叙事的一次修正：data 仍然是跨领域构建更强 intelligence 的基础组件之一。
original: 好的 data 编码了极高价值的知识、品味和 expertise，常常以过去不存在的方式被表达和结构化。
Data 将继续成为 intelligence industry 的核心。

sections.title: The Plugin and Safety Layer / 插件与安全层
sections.desc: agent 生态继续向两端扩张：一端是更容易连接工具和技能，另一端是企业级的安全控制。

rewrite: Claude is collapsing connectors and skills into a single concept: plugins. The product pitch is simple—one way to connect tools, teach Claude a new skill, or do both—with 10,000+ plugins available across Free, Pro, Max and Ultra plans.
original: There’s now one way to connect your tools to Claude, teach it a new skill, or do both.
Connectors and skills come together as plugins.
Browse 10,000+ plugins.

rewrite: Claude 正把 connectors 和 skills 合并成一个概念：plugins。产品逻辑很简单：用同一种方式连接工具、教 Claude 新技能，或者两件事一起做；目前 Free、Pro、Max 和 Ultra 计划都能使用 10,000+ plugins。
original: 现在有一种方式可以把工具连接到 Claude、教它新 skill，或者两件事都做。
Connectors 和 skills 合并成了 plugins。
浏览 10,000+ plugins。

rewrite: Anthropic says Enterprise Frontier Safeguards is now in public beta for eligible businesses with zero data retention. It looks for misuse across many requests while remaining compatible with ZDR, and was developed with more than 100 customers.

That is the less flashy but essential counterpart to the plugin boom: as agents get more access and autonomy, enterprise controls have to reason across a sequence of requests, not just inspect one prompt.
original: Zero data retention (ZDR) with Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) is now in public beta for eligible businesses.
It looks for misuse across many requests while remaining compatible with ZDR.
We developed it with over 100 customers.

rewrite: Anthropic 宣布，Enterprise Frontier Safeguards 已面向符合条件的企业开启 public beta，并支持 zero data retention。它会跨多次 request 检查 misuse，同时保持与 ZDR 兼容，且已经和 100 多家客户共同开发。
这是 plugin 浪潮不那么显眼、但同样必要的另一面：agent 获得更多访问权限和自主性之后，企业安全控制需要理解一连串 request，而不只是检查单个 prompt。
original: 带有 Enterprise Frontier Safeguards（EFS）的 zero data retention（ZDR）现在面向符合条件的企业进入 public beta。
它会跨多个 request 检查 misuse，同时保持与 ZDR 兼容。
我们与 100 多家客户共同开发了它。

sections.title: Experts in Front, Agents at Scale / 专家在前，Agent 在后
sections.desc: 服务业的变化不只是减少人手，而是让专家把判断放在前端，把执行产能交给 agent。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie sees agents changing the economics of services businesses. Historically, output scaled with headcount; agents decouple output from the amount of human time, so one engineer or designer can potentially produce what dozens did before.

But his caveat is the important part: this is not simply 'all agents'. Experts still need to sit at the front end and ensure the right outcomes are delivered. He expects the pattern across cybersecurity, advertising, legal, accounting and IT transformation.
original: Agents entirely change the calculus here, because now we can scale output in a way that’s decoupled from the among of time that goes in.
The key is to still have experts on the front end that actually can ensure the right outcomes are delivered from agents.
You’ll see this in cyber security, advertising and marketing, legal, accounting, IT transformation.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 认为，agent 正在改变服务业的经济模型。过去产能基本跟 headcount 一起增长；agent 把产出和投入的人类时间解绑，一个 engineer 或 designer 可能做出过去几十个人的产出。
但他特别强调，答案不是“全部交给 agent”：专家仍然要站在前端，确保 agent 交付的是正确结果。他预计这种模式会出现在 cyber security、广告营销、法律、会计和 IT transformation 等行业。
original: Agent 完全改变了这里的计算方式，因为现在我们可以让产出扩张，而不再绑定投入的时间。
关键是前端仍然要有专家，确保 agent 交付正确的结果。
你会在网络安全、广告营销、法律、会计和 IT transformation 里看到这一点。

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch describes a personal eval: he asked Fable to study all his coding sessions and decide whether Opus or Gemini Neon was better for him. It picked Neon.
The useful idea is not the winner, but the method: evaluate models against your own work and workflow instead of relying only on generic benchmarks.
original: I asked Fable to study all my coding sessions and decide whether Opus or Gemini Neon is best. Think of it as a 'personal eval'.
It picked Neon.

rewrite: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 做了一个 personal eval：让 Fable 研究他所有的 coding sessions，判断 Opus 和 Gemini Neon 哪个更适合自己，结果选中了 Neon。
有价值的不是谁赢了，而是方法：用自己的工作和 workflow 评估模型，而不是只看通用 benchmark。
original: 我让 Fable 研究我所有的 coding sessions，判断 Opus 还是 Gemini Neon 更好。可以把它看作一个 personal eval。
它选了 Neon。
